errors.text: The proposed material is a W-Ta-Cr-V refractory BCC alloy rather than the as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA with FCC and B2 phases.
The transition is formulated primarily as a function of aging time at fixed temperature, whereas the target transition is temperature-dependent, with embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
The cited evidence does not establish the required prior chemical-ordering evidence: enhanced L12 ordering toward Ni3Al stoichiometry, its temperature dependence, or its connection to ductility.
The proposed coherency/coarsening mechanism omits the decisive coupling between L12 ordering, elevated APBE, planar slip, jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries, and crack initiation at phase-boundary tips.
Claims of greater than 10% initial elongation, approximately 800 MPa strength, and aging-time-dependent ductility recovery are not supported by the cited evidence.
